en.title: Interrogative pronouns
en.summary: Interrogative pronouns ask about people, things, choices and owners.

paragraphs: An interrogative pronoun begins a question and replaces the information that is asked for. The main ones are who, whom, whose, what and which.

blocks.html:
PronounAsks aboutExample
whoa person (subject or object)Who lives here?
whoma person (object, formal)Whom did you meet?
whosean ownerWhose is this?
whata thing or an ideaWhat happened?
whicha choice from a known groupWhich do you prefer?

paragraphs: Who is the subject or the object of a question. Whom is the formal object form, used mainly in writing and after prepositions: To whom did you speak? In everyday speech, people say Who did you speak to?
When the pronoun is the subject, the verb follows directly, with no do or does: Who called? When it is the object, the auxiliary comes before the subject: Who did you call?

blocks.html:
Pronoun is...OrderExample
subjectpronoun + verbWho knows the answer?
objectpronoun + auxiliary + subject + verbWhat did he say?
with a prepositionpronoun + auxiliary + subject + verb + prepositionWho are you talking to?

paragraphs: Adding -ever makes the question stronger and more emotional: Whatever happened? Whoever did this? They also work as relative pronouns: Take whichever you like.

items: Wrong: **Who did call you?** Right: **Who called you?**
Wrong: **What you want?** Right: **What do you want?**
Wrong: **Which is your name?** Right: **What is your name?** (there is no limited choice)

ro.title: Pronumele interogative
ro.summary: Pronumele interogative țin locul unui substantiv și ajută la formularea întrebărilor despre persoane sau lucruri.

paragraphs: Pronumele interogative se folosesc pentru a pune întrebări. Ele țin locul substantivului așteptat ca răspuns. Cele mai importante pronume interogative sunt „cine”, „ce”, „care” și „cât”.

Pronumele interogativ stă de obicei la începutul întrebării. Pronumele „cine” se folosește doar pentru persoane. Pronumele „ce” nu își schimbă niciodată forma (este invariabil). Pronumele „care” se folosește pentru a alege dintr-un grup cunoscut.

blocks.html:
PronumeÎntreabă despreExemplu
cineo persoanăCine vorbește?
ceun lucru sau o acțiuneCe faci acum?
careo alegere dintr-un grupCare este al tău?
al cuiposesorul unui lucruAl cui este telefonul?
cât, câtă, câți, câteo cantitate sau un numărCâți au sosit?
